tagline: Fireworks that hit on the drop.
target_audience: TikTok dancers, hype choreographers, and content creators shooting in Phnom Penh, Cambodia (Riverside, Koh Pich, Independence Monument)

rules.h1: font-black tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white font-['Outfit']
rules.h2: font-bold tracking-tight text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white font-['Outfit']
rules.h3: font-bold tracking-tight text-lg sm:text-xl text-white font-['Outfit']
rules.tagline: text-sm sm:text-base tracking-wide font-medium text-[#FFD043] font-['Outfit'] uppercase
rules.timeline_badge: font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded tracking-wider

layout_and_structure.container: max-w-md mx-auto px-4 py-5 min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between relative z-10

header.description: Sticky top bar with glass background, brand logo with spark/firework indicator, Phnom Penh badge (1 USD = 4,100 KHR tag), and catalog modal trigger

hero_voice_zone.description: Massive central Push-To-Talk microphone button with interactive pulse rings, live audio-wave visualization, and tactile hold/tap states

mic_states.idle: bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#FF2A85] via-[#E11D48] to-[#FFD043] shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(255,42,133,0.6)] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform
mic_states.recording: animate-pulse ring-8 ring-[#FF2A85]/40 bg-[#FF2A85] shadow-[0_0_55px_rgba(255,42,133,0.9)] scale-110
mic_states.processing: animate-spin border-4 border-t-[#FFD043] border-r-transparent border-b-[#FF2A85] border-l-transparent

dual_input_zone.transcript_box: Neon bordered transcript bubble displaying real-time or transcribed voice request with quick edit capability
dual_input_zone.text_input_fallback: Visible text area with neon focus ring, Phnom Penh dance vibe chips (e.g. 'Koh Pich Sunset Drop', 'Riverside Bass Boost', 'Independence Plaza 12s Drop', 'Royal Palace Sparkler Squad')
dual_input_zone.generate_button: High-impact CTA 'BUILD SHOT KIT' with gold-spark accents and instant feedback

structure: Card Header: Kit Name (e.g., 'Koh Pich Bass Drop 15s Kit'), Song Title & Artist, Drop Second highlight badge (e.g. '💥 DROP AT 0:08s')
15-Second Interactive Visual Scrub/Timeline: Horizontal 0-15s bar marking cue positions and drop moment
Vertical Cue List: 4-6 timed steps showing [Second (0:02s), Firework Name, Effect description (e.g. Crackling Gold Comet), Placement & Safety Tip (e.g. 5m behind dancer left)]
Filming Tip Box: Pro TikTok camera angle, lighting trick, and FPS advice (e.g. 'Shoot 4K 60fps low-angle tracking forward on 0:07s for slow-mo drop explosion')
Cart & Currency Breakdown: Line items table (Item, Qty, Unit Price, Line Total) with both USD ($) and Cambodian Riel (KHR ៛) total calculation using official standard rate (1 USD = 4,100 KHR)
Action Buttons: 'Order to TukTuk / Grab Delivery' and 'Share Shot Kit to TikTok Crew'

catalog_drawer_modal.description: Quick view of Phnom Penh dancer approved pyrotechnic gear: cold spark fountains, neon smoke flares, strobe strobes, Roman candle cakes, safe hand sparklers with specs and prices

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, one-page single page application for BoomDrop in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
Do NOT create multiple pages or login screens. The app is zero-friction, one-page.

Implement Web Speech API (webkitSpeechRecognition/SpeechRecognition) for the push-to-talk mic button, with a solid fallback audio simulation/preset voice recognition if microphone permissions are denied or unsupported in browser.

Provide presets/chips for rapid testing of TikTok dance scenarios (e.g., '5 Dancers, Koh Pich, Pop Anthem drop at 0:08s, $35 budget', 'Solo Shuffler at Riverside, Phonk Beat drop at 0:06s, $20 budget').
Include both push-to-talk speech AND a visible fallback text input textarea that stays synced with the transcript.

Ensure LLM Shot Kit builder handles: kit_name, song, drop_second, 4-6 timed cues (second, item_id, effect, placement_tip), filming_tip, cart (items with id, name, qty, price_usd, total_usd, total_khr). Rate: 1 USD = 4,100 KHR.
Show the 15-second timeline with drop second glowing in neon pink and gold.
Add audio playback or sound click effects when tapping mic and triggering cues.
Include a Catalog Modal/Drawer allowing dancers to browse fireworks inventory with prices in USD and KHR.
Provide a simulated 15-second rehearsal preview player that runs a timer 0s -> 15s and highlights each cue as it hits!
Add comprehensive data-testid attributes to all buttons, mic, transcript, text input, cue list items, and cart total.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not use 'transition: all'; specify transition-colors, transition-transform, etc.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text or dropdown menus; always provide dark translucent backdrops like bg-[#0D0F1A]/95 backdrop-blur-md
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.theme_cohesion: Keep deep void dark sky (#06070D) background with neon pink (#FF2A85) and warm gold (#FFD043) accents consistently across cards, borders, and buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.mobile_padding: Keep padding safe on mobile screens (max-w-md mx-auto) and maintain accessible touch targets (>48px for mic and key actions).
